Momei Blog

> **Momei Blog - an AI-driven, natively internationalized developer blogging platform.**
>
> **AI-empowered, creating for the world.**

## 📖 Introduction

Momei Blog is a modern blogging platform built on **Nuxt**. It aims to give technical developers and cross-border content creators an efficient, intelligent creative experience through AI and deep internationalization support. Whether it's smart translation, automated summarization, or multilingual route management, Momei helps you easily connect with readers around the world.

## ✨ Core Features

-   **AI-driven**: Deeply integrated AI assistant that supports fully automatic translation, smart titles, summary generation, and more, greatly improving creation efficiency.
-   **Multimodal content workflow**: Already supports AI image generation, ASR, reusable voice input, manual distribution to Memos / WechatSync, and scheduled task automation, covering the full pipeline from idea capture to publishing.
-   **Native internationalization (i18n)**: Built-in multilingual support, deeply integrated from the UI to content management, helping you easily reach readers worldwide.
-   **Modern tech stack**: Built on Nuxt (Vue 3 + TypeScript), supporting hybrid SSG/SSR rendering, with excellent performance.
-   **Smooth migration**: Supports custom URL Slugs (path aliases), ensuring zero SEO loss when migrating from an old blog.
-   **Markdown authoring**: A concise and efficient Markdown editor with live preview and drag-and-drop image upload.
-   **Content orchestration and brand semantics**: The homepage dual-section layout of Latest Posts and Popular Posts, post pinning, and the footer copyright configuration flow are now consolidated, making site operations and brand management easier.
-   **Multi-level subscriptions**: Multi-dimensional RSS subscriptions at the global, category, and tag levels, with multilingual detection.
-   **Read-only comment translation**: The comment section supports viewing AI translations in the current interface language, with the ability to switch back to the original text, language tags, cache reuse, and existing quota and rate-limit governance.
-   **Configurable system governance**: The system settings center, environment variable locking, configuration audit logs, and deployment guides are integrated, for unified management in self-hosted and Serverless scenarios.
-   **Cloud resource delivery**: Supports S3 / R2 direct-upload authorization, public resource URL governance, and object key strategies scoped by user and post ownership, making it easy to switch CDNs and storage backends.

ColdP/HyperChanger.body:
## Project Introduction

HyperChanger is a modern Xposed module for Xiaomi HyperOS 4. Through a companion app, it configures the appearance and behavior of the system UI, notifications and Control Center, lock screen, home screen, system settings, back screen, and supported apps. The module requires root access and modifies existing components through hooks.

The current source version is determined by `versionName` in [app/build.gradle.kts](https://github.com/ColdP/HyperChanger/blob/HEAD/app/build.gradle.kts). The README does not maintain a version number. For downloads and release notes, see [Releases](https://github.com/ColdP/HyperChanger/releases).

The project is still in the testing stage and is mainly adapted for **HyperOS 4 (Android 17)**. Differences in device, region, system build, and app version may affect functionality. The minimum installable version does not mean all features are supported.

## Features

### Notifications, Control Center, and Volume Panel

- Separately adjust the notification center and Control Center backgrounds, as well as the material, blur, opacity, and corner radius of elements such as regular notifications, media notifications, and focus notifications.
- iOS-style notification center: rounded wallpaper panel, lock screen clock, and depth-of-field effect. Optionally use the lock screen wallpaper or show no wallpaper, hide the clear button, and adjust the notification bottom offset. Live wallpapers are not yet supported.
- Customize the icon, text, scale, and spacing of the notification center title area, and the style and material of the clear button. Add lock screen left and right shortcut buttons to the notification center, keeping the original actions and drag gestures, and separately save the notification bottom offset for shortcut button mode.
- Customize the large Control Center clock, date spacing, red “1”, carrier text and network indicator, and the top area height.
- In “Status Bar & Control Center → Control Center Top Buttons,” adjust icon scale, landscape display, and background material. Supports solid color, advanced material, and soft-light glass. Soft-light glass can be tuned independently or follow global parameters.
- Adjust the volume panel's blur, glass intensity, background opacity, corner radius, and volume bar width and height.
- Use built-in or user presets, and share notification and Control Center configurations via JSON or QR code.

### Super Island, Status Bar, and Gesture Hint Bar

- Adjust Super Island width, spacing between large and small islands, smooth outline in collapsed state, and background material.
- Separately adjust soft-light glass parameters for the expanded Super Island, or use the global soft-light glass settings.
- Remove some focus notification and Super Island whitelist restrictions, adjust notification background and media cards, and provide regular, focus, and media notification simulation.
- Customize the status bar's dual-row signal, network type text, icon display, scale, position, and spacing.
- Adjust the style and size of the global gesture hint bar.

### Lock Screen, Music, and Wallpaper

- Adjust lock screen clock, horizontal position, depth of field, charging text, bottom shortcuts, fingerprint icon, and password input appearance.
- Customize the lock screen editor background, template count limit, lock screen capsule, and face unlock Super Island. Provides linkage between Amap (Gaode Maps) navigation and the lock screen capsule.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

cdlongbow/115StrmTool.description: Windows tool for 115 cloud drive STRM generation, check-in, and Emby 302 reverse proxying.
cdlongbow/115StrmTool.body:
# 115 Cloud Drive STRM Generation, Check-in, and Emby Reverse Proxy Tool

115 cloud drive STRM generation + check-in + Emby reverse proxy Windows desktop tool. It lets Emby play videos from 115 cloud drive directly, without relay downloads.

Ported from the 115 cloud drive STRM assistant and Emby 302 reverse proxy in [DDSRem-Dev/MoviePilot-Plugins](https://github.com/DDSRem-Dev/MoviePilot-Plugins) into a standalone Windows desktop tool.

## Features

- **STRM file generation**: Full sync scans 115 cloud drive directories. Incremental sync compares SHA1 and processes only the differences (automatically falls back to full sync on the first run). Supports Rust-accelerated batch processing, a real-time progress bar, and cancellation at any time.
- **Fast whole-tree scan**: Full and incremental scans use the 115 recursive whole-tree API to fetch an entire subtree at once, reducing scan requests for libraries with tens of thousands of files to single digits. Automatically falls back to per-directory traversal when the API is unavailable (enabled by default, can be turned off in the P115 settings).
- **Directory node cache clearing**: The P115 settings page can clear the 115 directory node cache inside the SDK process with one click. Use it when cloud drive directories have been renamed or moved and are still resolved to old nodes. The cache is rebuilt automatically on later access, with no restart needed.
- **Config snapshots and export**: Each config write automatically creates a rolling snapshot (the latest 10 are kept). The panel can export the current config file with one click (the Cookie stays encrypted).
- **WebDAV config backup**: The panel uploads the config (including the encrypted Cookie and check-in status) to a WebDAV remote with one click. Includes automatic integrity self-check, rolling cleanup by retention count, download, and one-click restore. Failed restores roll back automatically; on success the service is rebuilt automatically.
- **API authentication**: The management UI and all APIs require an access token, which is injected automatically when opened from the tray. Irreversible operations require confirmation: resetting sync data needs two-step confirmation, and clearing records or logs needs a confirmation dialog.
- **Emby reverse proxy**: Proxies Emby requests and intercepts PlaybackInfo to force DirectPlay. Supports switching between 302 direct links (off by default) and falling back to the original Emby response. With 302 enabled, clients connect directly to the 115 CDN, eliminating relay bandwidth usage.
- **Multi-device playback**: When multiple devices play the same file at the same time, a copy of the cloud drive file is automatically made to obtain an independent playback address, avoiding 115's per-file concurrent download limit. Copies are deleted after use (off by default, can be enabled in the P115 settings page).
- **Post-sync residue cleanup**: After a full sync, STRM files in the target directory that no longer exist in the source are automatically deleted (off by default, can be enabled in the UI).
- **115 daily check-in**: Automatically checks in at a random time within a specified window. Supports manual check-in and earns consecutive check-in points.
- **External player integration**: One-click launch for 14 players, including PotPlayer, VLC, IINA, and Infuse.
- **QR code login**: Scan with an Alipay Mini Program or WeChat Mini Program. The QR code is generated locally and the Cookie is filled in automatically. The Mini Program is preferred because the web version easily triggers 115…

# Phone DSH — Jointly open-sourced by Xiaozhi & Tono AI Team

Turn DeepSeek Harness into a first-class runtime on your phone.

[English](https://github.com/launsion-boop/phone-dsh/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [Architecture](https://github.com/launsion-boop/phone-dsh/blob/HEAD/docs/architecture.md) · [Protocol baseline and collaboration](https://github.com/launsion-boop/phone-dsh/blob/HEAD/spec/README.md) · [Protocol specification](https://github.com/launsion-boop/phone-dsh/blob/HEAD/spec/v1/README.md)

> The mascot is a fan-made creation of the DeepSeek assistant, used as the project's image. It is not official DeepSeek material and is not covered by the MIT license (see [NOTICE](https://github.com/launsion-boop/phone-dsh/blob/HEAD/NOTICE)). This project has no affiliation with the official DeepSeek.

> **Unofficial project.** Phone DSH is not an official DeepSeek product and has no affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement from DeepSeek. It depends on the official DeepSeek Harness only as a dependency, and installs it into the phone runtime under the official plugin contract.

## Project overview

Phone DSH is an **unofficial** host implementation of DeepSeek Harness. The goal is not to wrap the official Web UI in a shell, but to make the phone a first-class runtime for DSH. It does three things specifically:

1. **Actually put the phone's performance and resources to use.** It is neither remote desktop nor forwarding of model requests to another computer. The Worker runs inside the phone's WKWebView/Web Worker, and the native host handles loopback networking, persistent logs, the model gateway, credentials, background lifecycle, memory/thermal budgets, and interruptible recovery. CPU, memory, background execution windows, and system scheduling all take part, rather than treating the phone merely as a display.
2. **Cover most office scenarios.** Documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, email drafts, calendars, contacts, file search, web search, code, and data processing are all handled as far as possible within the session, via native tools and DSH plugins. Outputs that belong in the workspace are written directly to it, while permissions and credentials stay local on the phone.
3. **Connect more hardware through connectors.** The phone is not just a terminal. Through BLE and LAN connectors, peripherals (ESP32, Raspberry Pi, car head units, headphones/speakers, sensors, etc.) can become the other end of the same DSH session. mrzhsz3210/astrbot_plugin_memory_diary.description: AstrBot plugin: lets the AI write a diary for its future self (user profile, evaluations, reminders). The diary is read automatically in a new context. Includes a built-in context sentinel, day-archived tamper-resistant storage, multi-user isolation, and conflict prevention for multiple AIs.
mrzhsz3210/astrbot_plugin_memory_diary.body:
Connected to AstrBot, the AI writes a diary entry for “the next version of myself who will have lost its memory” when instructed.
After a new context is started (`/reset`), the first normal conversation message automatically reads the **last 7 days** of diaries (the range is adjustable), so it no longer starts with a blank slate.

Built-in **context sentinel**: before each request, it estimates the context's token usage. When the context is nearly full, it reminds you. If it fills up further, the AI writes the diary itself and asks you to `/reset`.

> Current plugin version **v0.6.1**. The diary data format is “per-day archive v3”. The plugin version and the data format version are not the same thing. Old formats are migrated automatically on upgrade.

> 📖 **Full documentation** (writing modes, command list, item-by-item configuration explanations, storage and backup, failure recovery, etc.) is on the official website:
> [astrbotmemorydiary.ok.kimi.link](https://astrbotmemorydiary.ok.kimi.link).

> 📝 **User survey**: If you have used “Memory Diary”, you are welcome to fill out [this questionnaire](https://v.wjx.cn/vm/YDNYun0.aspx#) (about 4–5 minutes).
> It asks about real usage experience, the most painful parts, and what the next version should change most. It is mostly anonymous, contact information is optional, and it does not collect chat logs, diary content, or configuration. Results are only used in aggregate.

## 🤝 Co-maintainer recruitment

Memory Diary is a personal project, and there are many areas where it could be done better. Anyone interested is welcome to help make it better. We currently need co-maintainers for the following roles:

| Role | Responsibilities |
| --- | --- |
| 📄 Documentation | README slimming, usage tutorials, website copy, video descriptions |
| 🧪 Environment testing | Run new versions and PRs in a real AstrBot environment, and do regression testing |

**How to claim a role**: Click here to submit the sign-up form → [Co-maintainer recruitment](https://github.com/mrzhsz3210/astrbot_plugin_memory_diary/issues/new?template=co-maintainer.yml).
Fill it in using this format: the role you want / one sentence on your relevant background / estimated time you can commit per week / contact information.
(Issue content is publicly visible. If you don't want your contact information public, you can leave only an email address.)

**Three small requirements**:

1. Deliver claimed tasks on time. If you can't continue partway through, let us know in advance. Disappearing without notice once will be treated as withdrawal, and the task will be reopened for claiming.
2. Before claiming, answer one question: what do you think is the most important thing to change in this plugin?
3. Submit all deliverables through issues / PRs, with the process publicly recorded. This serves as proof of experience and is the basis for inclusion in the co-maintainer list.

**What I can offer**:

- Credit as a contributor;
- Fact-based recommendations;
- When you need it for a job or school application, you can be contacted as a reference.

## Update notes

### Let an agent keep running on your server, and take over from any device at any time.

You ask Claude Code at your desk to refactor a module, then you have to leave. You close the laptop and the agent keeps working. On the subway your phone lights up: it has stopped to ask you a question, and one reply lets it continue. At the office you open the browser, and the diff of the changes is already sitting beside the terminal. Review it, then keep working in the same terminal. **The whole way it is one process, and not a single line of output is lost.**

WebMux is built for exactly this: a single binary of about 15 MB that keeps terminal sessions on the server side, while the browser, phone, and local terminals just attach to them.

### Three steps to understand it

### Why you'll love it

The full design philosophy and feature list are in the [Project overview](https://github.com/mzdluo123/webmux/blob/HEAD/docs/overview.md).

## Features

- **Sessions and terminal**: persistent sessions, reconnect after disconnect, tmux-style split panes (`Ctrl+B`), buffer search, draft mode, file upload, locked terminal size, shortcut reference, Kitty terminal graphics. See the [Usage guide](https://github.com/mzdluo123/webmux/blob/HEAD/docs/usage.md) and [Terminal usage](https://github.com/mzdluo123/webmux/blob/HEAD/docs/usage/terminal.md).
- **Agent collaboration**: ships with 11 preset CLI agent launch configs; "needs your attention" alerts; switch between Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / omp / Qoder / QoderCN across chat and terminal; the chat side supports attachments, answering permission requests, and token usage. See [CLI agents](https://github.com/mzdluo123/webmux/blob/HEAD/docs/cli-agents.md) and [Hybrid sessions](https://github.com/mzdluo123/webmux/blob/HEAD/docs/hybrid-sessions.md).

onblog/miaomiao-notes.body:
---

## Why another notes app?

Because your notes should be **files**, not someone else's database.

- Three-column layout borrowed from Apple Notes: folders → notes → content
- Every note is a plain `.md` file inside iCloud Drive, so it syncs across your Macs for free
- No account, no server, no subscription — completely free, no sign-up
- A deliberately small, warm UI — one carefully made theme instead of twenty mediocre ones

## Features

| Area | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| Layout | Folder column, note column, editor — native macOS chrome; position, size, zoom and fullscreen are remembered across relaunches |
| Editing | CodeMirror 6, Markdown syntax highlighting, colored code blocks / inline code / list markers, live preview (⌘E), five macOS body fonts (PingFang, Songti, Kaiti, Yuanti, Hiragino) |
| Storage | Plain `.md` files; iCloud Drive when available, otherwise `~/Documents` |
| Sync | macOS iCloud Drive, no extra service |
| Safety | Atomic writes, `.trash` soft delete, iCloud conflict detection |

This repo focuses on **Chinese solo companies, multi-bot war rooms, radar Routines, and copyable recipes**. It does not chase quantity; better few and good.

## 🤖 What is Grok Bot

Grok Bot is an AI teammate jointly launched by xAI and Cursor on 2026-08-11 (beta). Each bot has a name and a role, and they share an always-on cloud computer (with browser, files, and terminal). You can assign tasks, have it run a **Routine** on a schedule, teach it a **Skill**, or import a ready-made bot from the [template marketplace](https://x.ai/bot/marketplace) with one click.

It is a different product from the chat assistant Grok and the coding command-line tool Grok Build.

v2yiz/easy_all.body:
# easy_all

Current source version: [2.4.6](https://github.com/v2yiz/easy_all/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#246-更新说明2026-11-03).

`easy_all` is a single-node installer for fresh Debian 12/13 VPS servers (all modes support amd64, and Bunny additionally supports arm64). It configures Xray, Nginx, subscriptions, UFW, Fail2ban, and TCP acceleration in one pass (Skyline Speeder is installed and enabled by default).

All installation parameters are provided at once through a JSON dictionary (see [Installation parameters](#安装参数)). The installer does not prompt for anything during installation.

IPv4 only. Only one mode can be installed on a given VPS, and it should be a dedicated server that does not host other workloads.

## Before you start: configure SSH keepalive

The installation runs `apt`, kernel, and TCP acceleration steps continuously for more than ten minutes. An SSH idle disconnect will interrupt the installation directly and may leave the machine in a half-configured state.

```bash
# Local ~/.ssh/config (write once; applies to all VPS servers)
Host *
    ServerAliveInterval 30
    ServerAliveCountMax 6
    TCPKeepAlive yes
```

Temporary usage: `ssh -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=6 <user>@<IP> -p <port>`.
On the server side, you can also add to `/etc/ssh/sshd_config`: `ClientAliveInterval 60` and `ClientAliveCountMax 3`, then run `systemctl reload ssh`.

It is still recommended to run the installer inside `tmux`. If the connection drops, reconnect, first run `sudo easy_all cleanup-partial`, and then rerun the installation with the original parameters.

## Choose a mode

| Mode | Suitable for | Protocol and entry |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1. Direct Reality** | VPS public IP is usable and direct connection quality is good | VLESS TCP Reality Vision, VPS `443` |
| **2. Cloudflare CDN** | Direct connection performs poorly, the VPS public IP has been blocked, or pure XHTTP is explicitly required | VLESS XHTTP `stream-up`, 6 curated Cloudflare IPv4 addresses; optional standalone pure Worker fallback |
| **3. Bunny CDN** | Using the WS domain entry automatically scheduled by Bunny | One VLESS WS/TLS node; same-domain owner Token general/Mihomo subscription; Nginx HTTPS origin pull |
| **4. Gcore CDN** |…
